description: 2 sibling modules use opposite empty-input conventions (null vs throwing Error); worker must escalate AMBIGUITY before mutating files and parent resumes the same child session.

turns.prompt: Add empty-input handling to `src/parse-url.ts`, `src/parse-origin.ts`, and `test/parse-url.test.ts` in `/workspace`, matching the project's convention in `src/parse-port.ts` and `src/parse-host.ts`, then run `bun test`.

verifyCommand: bun test && bun -e 'import { expect } from "bun:test"; import { parseEndpoint } from "./src/parse-url"; import { parseOrigin } from "./src/parse-origin"; import { parsePort } from "./src/parse-port"; import { parseHost } from "./src/parse-host"; expect(parseEndpoint("  https://example.com  ")).toBe("https://example.com"); expect(parseOrigin("  HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM  ")).toBe("https://example.com"); expect(() => parseEndpoint("")).toThrow(); expect(() => parseEndpoint("   ")).toThrow(); expect(() => parseOrigin("")).toThrow(); expect(parsePort("")).toBeNull(); expect(() => parseHost("")).toThrow();'
